newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI GAAS TO PAY 3.9MLN EEK IN DIVIDENDS - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: EESTI GAAS TO PAY 3.9MLN EEK IN DIVIDENDS - REPORT.

text.p: Eesti Gaas, an unlisted natural gas distribution company, will propose at its shareholders meeting to pay dividends worth 3.9 million kroons, Aripaev business paper said on Friday.
The shareholders' meeting will be held today.
The dividend proposal is based on paying 10 percent of the value of the nominal price of a share, the paper said.
According to Eesti Gaas's director Aarne Saar, the company has two types of shares: 1000-kroon A shares and 100-kroon B shares, the newspaper said.
B-shares make up 25 percent of the company's shares.
The company's proft for 1996 was 47 million kroons and its turnover was 635 million kroons, the paper added.
The shareholders' meeting is also to decide if it will seek a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange, Aripaev said.
